'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Robbie Hendon DS A Stunning Move''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Robbie Hendon]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name '''Remembering Blake Huffman'''. Username '''rhendon'''. L4 Insidious Prisoner → Insignificant Prisoners (V). L40/43 Galen, Secret Apprentice → Galen Marek (V). L41 IG Bodyguard Droid → IG-88 (V). L45/49/53 Battle Droid Squad → Battle Droid.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage|A Stunning Move / A Valuable Hostage (V)]]
* '''Username:''' rhendon
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
